description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultNotesRepository class of the note organizer Android application. It tests creation, deletion, synchronization, conflict resolution, updates, and search mechanisms of notes within the repository.

classes.name: DefaultNotesRepositoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of DefaultNotesRepository, covering creation, deletion, synchronization, conflict handling, updates, and search functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes in-memory database, API mock, and repository instance before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the database after each test.

methods.name: create_updates_flow_and_persists
methods.description: Tests that creating a note updates the observable flow and persists the note across repository instances.

methods.name: delete_tombstone_removes_from_observed_list
methods.description: Verifies that deleting a note removes it from the observed list.

methods.name: sync_marks_dirty_clean_and_uploads_to_api
methods.description: Tests synchronization process marking notes as clean and uploading them to remote API.

methods.name: conflict_last_write_wins_prefers_newer_updatedAt
methods.description: Checks that in case of conflict, the note with the newer 'updatedAt' timestamp prevails.

methods.name: update_preserves_createdAt_and_marks_dirty
methods.description: Ensures that updating a note preserves its creation timestamp, updates its 'updatedAt' timestamp, and marks it as dirty.

methods.name: search_is_reactive_and_filters_by_title_or_content
methods.description: Validates that search queries are reactive, filtering notes by title or content and updating results accordingly.
